title: Architectural Degradation: How to Measure and to Remediate
title_zh: 架构退化：如何度量与修复

paragraphs.en: Context. Architectural degradation undermines software maintainability, evolvability, and quality. However, existing research remains fragmented across measurement approaches, metrics, tools, and remediation strategies, limiting our understanding of how these elements relate across the degradation lifecycle.
paragraphs.zh: 背景。 架构退化会损害软件的维护性、演进性和质量。 然而，现有研究在测量方法、指标、工具和修复策略方面仍显得零散，这限制了我们对这些要素在整个退化生命周期中相互关系的理解。

sents.zh: 背景。

paragraphs.en: Aim. We consolidate the state of the art on architectural degradation by examining how researchers measure it, which metrics and tools support its assessment, and how existing approaches address remediation.
paragraphs.zh: 目标。 我们通过研究研究人员如何衡量架构退化、哪些指标和工具支持其评估，以及现有方法如何应对修复问题，来整合当前关于架构退化的研究现状。

paragraphs.en: Method. We conducted a Multivocal Literature Review of 284 peer-reviewed and grey-literature studies. We supported screening, data extraction, and classification with a locally executed LLM-assisted pipeline combining Retrieval-Augmented Generation, multi-model validation, and human adjudication. We then analyzed the resulting taxonomies and their cross-dimensional relationships.
paragraphs.zh: 方法。 我们对 284 项经过同行评审和灰色文献研究进行了多视角文献综述。 我们通过一个本地运行的、由大语言模型辅助的流程来支持筛选、数据提取和分类，该流程结合了检索增强生成、多模型验证和人工裁定。 随后，我们分析了由此产生的分类体系及其跨维度的关系。

paragraphs.en: Results and Conclusions. We identified 277 measurement approaches, 357 metrics, 238 tools, and 395 remediation approaches. Research strongly concentrates on static and structural analysis, structural metrics, and detection-oriented tools. In contrast, remediation spans heterogeneous code-level, architectural, and organizational interventions and shows substantially less consolidation. Overall, the field has developed a mature diagnostic apparatus but has made less progress in connecting degradation detection with effective remediation. Our results provide a structured view of the available techniques and identify the diagnosis–remediation gap as a key direction for future research.
paragraphs.zh: 结果与结论。 我们识别出 277 种测量方法、357 项指标、238 种工具和 395 种修复方法。 研究主要集中在静态和结构分析、结构指标以及以检测为导向的工具上。 相比之下，修复措施涵盖了异构的代码级、架构和组织层面的干预手段，且整合程度明显较低。 总体而言，该领域已发展出一套成熟的诊断体系，但在将退化检测与有效修复相结合方面进展有限。 我们的研究结果对现有技术提供了结构化的视角，并指出诊断与修复之间的鸿沟是未来研究的关键方向。

paragraphs.en: Software architecture underpins the long-term maintainability, modifiability, scalability, and evolvability of a system ( Herold et al., 2016 ) . Yet as systems evolve to meet new requirements, technologies, and business constraints, their implementation inevitably drifts away from the intended design. This phenomenon, architectural degradation or erosion , gradually erodes architectural integrity and threatens sustainability ( Herold and Mair, 2014 ; Perry and Wolf, 1992 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 软件架构支撑着系统的长期可维护性、可修改性、可扩展性和可演化性（Herold 等，2016）。 然而，随着系统为满足新的需求、技术和业务约束而不断演进，其实现方式不可避免地偏离了最初的设计。 这种现象，即架构退化或侵蚀，会逐渐削弱架构的完整性并威胁到系统的可持续性（Herold 和 Mair，2014；Perry 和 Wolf，1992）。

sents.en: Software architecture underpins the long-term maintainability, modifiability, scalability, and evolvability of a system ( Herold et al., 2016 ) .
sents.zh: 软件架构支撑着系统的长期可维护性、可修改性、可扩展性和可演化性（Herold 等，2016）。

sents.en: This phenomenon, architectural degradation or erosion , gradually erodes architectural integrity and threatens sustainability ( Herold and Mair, 2014 ; Perry and Wolf, 1992 ) .
sents.zh: 这种现象，即架构退化或侵蚀，会逐渐削弱架构的完整性并威胁到系统的可持续性（Herold 和 Mair，2014；Perry 和 Wolf，1992）。

paragraphs.en: Degradation is rarely the result of a single poor decision. It accumulates through continuous evolution, undocumented changes, architectural violations, growing dependency complexity, and routine maintenance. Over time, systems become harder to understand, maintain, and extend, while organizations face rising costs and mounting architectural technical debt ( Lenarduzzi et al., 2021 ) . Understanding how to identify, measure, and remediate architectural degradation has therefore become a pressing research and industrial challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 系统退化很少是单一错误决策的结果。 它是通过持续演化、未记录的变化、架构违规、依赖关系日益复杂以及日常维护而逐渐累积的。 随着时间的推移，系统变得越来越难以理解、维护和扩展，同时组织也面临不断上升的成本和日益严重的架构技术债务（Lenarduzzi 等人，2021）。 因此，了解如何识别、衡量并修复架构退化问题，已成为一个紧迫的研究和工业挑战。

sents.zh: 系统退化很少是单一错误决策的结果。

sents.en: Understanding how to identify, measure, and remediate architectural degradation has therefore become a pressing research and industrial challenge.
sents.zh: 因此，了解如何识别、衡量并修复架构退化问题，已成为一个紧迫的研究和工业挑战。

paragraphs.en: Over the past two decades, researchers have proposed a broad spectrum of techniques to tackle this challenge, including architecture conformance checking, architectural smell detection, dependency analysis, architecture recovery, software metrics, static and dynamic analysis, and, more recently, AI-assisted approaches ( Silva and Balasubramaniam, 2012 ; Li et al., 2021 ) . Numerous tools support degradation assessment, and remediation strategies have been proposed at the code, architectural, organizational, and runtime levels. Despite this substantial body of work, the knowledge remains fragmented. Existing secondary studies typically examine only isolated aspects, metrics, recovery, or erosion detection, making it difficult to see how measurement approaches, metrics, tools, and remediation strategies relate to one another. Consequently, researchers and practitioners still lack a unified view of the architectural degradation landscape and the connections among its fundamental building blocks.
paragraphs.zh: 在过去二十年间，研究人员提出了广泛的技术来应对这一挑战，包括架构合规性检查、架构异味检测、依赖分析、架构恢复、软件度量、静态和动态分析，以及近期出现的 AI 辅助方法（Silva 和 Balasubramaniam，2012；Li 等，2021）。 众多工具支持退化评估，并且已在代码、架构、组织及运行时层面提出了相应的修复策略。 尽管已有大量相关研究，但相关知识仍然零散不成体系。 现有的二次研究通常仅考察孤立的方面、度量指标、恢复方法或退化检测，这使得我们难以理解测量方法、度量指标、工具和修复策略之间的相互关系。 因此，研究人员和实践者仍然缺乏对架构退化领域及其基本构成要素之间关联的统一认识。

paragraphs.en: To fill this gap, we conducted a Multivocal Literature Review (MLR) ( Garousi et al., 2019 ) that synthesizes evidence from both peer-reviewed and grey literature. To handle the large-scale analysis, we employed an LLM-assisted pipeline based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-model validation, and human adjudication. Beyond independently classifying the existing literature, we connect the resulting taxonomies through cross-dimensional and maturity analyses, providing an integrated perspective of the architectural degradation ecosystem. This study makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 为了填补这一空白，我们开展了一项多源文献综述（MLR）（Garousi 等，2019），综合了同行评审文献和非正式文献中的证据。 为处理大规模分析任务，我们采用了一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）、多模型验证和人工裁决的、由大型语言模型辅助的流程。 除了对现有文献进行独立分类外，我们还通过跨维度和成熟度分析将所得分类体系相互关联，从而提供了一个关于架构退化生态系统的整合视角。 本研究做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: a comprehensive multivocal literature review on architectural degradation;
paragraphs.zh: 关于建筑劣化的全面多视角文献综述；

paragraphs.en: an integrated and maturity analysis of the research landscape.
paragraphs.zh: 对研究领域的综合与成熟度分析。

paragraphs.en: Our synthesis reveals a striking convergence: the community has built a mature, structurally focused diagnostic apparatus, static analysis, structural design metrics, and detection-oriented tooling dominate the field. In contrast, remediation remains fragmented across code-level, architectural, and organizational interventions, and the transition from detecting degradation to acting on it is still comparatively immature. These findings offer researchers a structured agenda for closing the diagnosis–remediation gap and give practitioners an evidence-based map of the techniques available for assessing and managing architectural degradation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的综合研究揭示了一个显著的趋势：该领域已经构建起一套成熟且注重结构的诊断体系，静态分析、结构设计指标以及以检测为导向的工具主导了整个领域。 相比之下，修复措施在代码层面、架构层面和组织层面的干预上仍然零散，而从检测到架构退化到采取相应行动的转变过程则相对不成熟。 这些发现为研究人员提供了填补诊断与修复之间差距的结构性议程，并为从业者提供了一份基于证据的路线图，帮助他们评估和管理架构退化问题。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we review existing studies and present a detailed comparison with our own research.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将回顾现有研究，并与我们的研究进行详细比较。

paragraphs.en: The evolution of software architecture topic over time has been extensively investigated in the software engineering literature. This section summarizes the most relevant contributions in this area, covering a variety of approaches and findings. The existing work addresses both conceptual frameworks and practical solutions, with a particular focus on improving recovery techniques and mitigating associated risks. However, a comprehensive understanding of architectural degradation requires examining not only how it is detected and measured, but also the tools that support its assessment and the strategies proposed for its remediation. In this regard, there remains a need for a comprehensive investigation integrating these complementary dimensions of architectural degradation.
paragraphs.zh: 软件架构主题随时间演变的历程，在软件工程文献中已得到广泛研究。 本节总结了该领域最相关的研究成果，涵盖了多种方法和发现。 现有工作既涉及概念框架，也包含实用解决方案，尤其注重改进恢复技术并降低相关风险。 然而，要全面理解架构退化，不仅需要研究其检测与测量方法，还需考察支持评估的工具以及提出的修复策略。 因此，仍有必要对架构退化的这些互补维度进行综合性研究。

paragraphs.en: To show how research in this area has evolved, we present the selected studies in chronological order. The earliest review was conducted by De Silva and Balasubramaniam ( Silva and Balasubramaniam, 2012 ) , while the most recent, to the best of our knowledge, is by Baabad et al. ( Baabad et al., 2022 ) . The primary objective of each study is summarized in Table 1 .

paragraphs.en: The study by De Silva and Balasubramaniam ( Silva and Balasubramaniam, 2012 ) provides structured overviews of architectural erosion, classifying existing techniques into prevention, minimization, and repair. The authors analyze the methodologies, tools, and processes associated with each category, emphasizing that architectural erosion cannot be effectively addressed through a single strategy. Instead, they advocate for a combined approach that integrates multiple techniques to manage the problem more comprehensively.
paragraphs.zh: De Silva 和 Balasubramaniam 的研究（Silva 和 Balasubramaniam，2012）对架构侵蚀提供了结构化的概述，将现有技术分为预防、最小化和修复三类。 作者分析了各类别相关的方法论、工具和流程，并强调仅靠单一策略无法有效应对架构侵蚀问题。 相反，他们主张采用一种综合方法，整合多种技术以更全面地管理该问题。

sents.en: The study by De Silva and Balasubramaniam ( Silva and Balasubramaniam, 2012 ) provides structured overviews of architectural erosion, classifying existing techniques into prevention, minimization, and repair.

paragraphs.en: Herold et al. ( Herold et al., 2016 ) conducted a literature review focusing on empirical studies related to architectural degradation and consistency checking. The objective was to assess the current state of research and identify areas that have been underexplored. Their findings indicate that many proposed solutions to remediate architectural degradation rely on case studies with limited generalizability. As a result, the authors highlight the need for more rigorous empirical validation, including controlled experiments and large-scale studies, to better understand the effectiveness of these approaches. These insights were later reinforced in their subsequent work, where they outlined a roadmap for future research ( Herold et al., 2016 ) .
paragraphs.zh: Herold 等人 （Herold 等人，2016）进行了一项文献综述，重点关注与架构退化及一致性检查相关的实证研究。 其目标是评估当前研究的现状，并识别出尚未充分探索的领域。 他们的研究结果表明，许多旨在修复架构退化的解决方案都依赖于案例研究，而这些案例研究的普遍适用性有限。 因此，作者们强调需要更严谨的实证验证，包括受控实验和大规模研究，以更好地理解这些方法的有效性。 这些见解后来在他们后续的研究中得到了进一步证实，其中他们为未来研究提出了一份路线图（Herold 等人，2016）。

paragraphs.en: The work by ( Zahid et al., 2017 ) examines the evolution of architecture recovery techniques, particularly the transition from manual to automated approaches. The study reflects the growing influence of industry demands for faster development cycles, which has driven the need for more efficient recovery methods. The authors emphasize the importance of maintaining architectural integrity in rapidly evolving systems and suggest that future research should focus on automated and semi-automated solutions.
paragraphs.zh: (Zahid 等人，2017) 的研究探讨了架构恢复技术的演变，特别是从手动方法向自动化方法的转变。 这项研究反映了行业对更快开发周期日益增长的需求所带来的影响，这种需求推动了更高效恢复方法的出现。 作者强调了在快速演变的系统中保持架构完整性的重要性，并建议未来的研究应聚焦于自动化和半自动化的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Sinkala et al. ( Sinkala et al., 2018 ) carried out a mapping study investigating the application of architecture recovery techniques in software product lines (SPLs). The study highlights the challenges of adapting approaches designed for single systems to the more complex SPL context. In particular, it identifies limitations in the handling of shared assets and the management of variability. The findings suggest that existing techniques do not adequately address architectural degradation in SPLs, especially in systems that evolve from cloned or ad hoc codebases and accumulate technical debt over time.
paragraphs.zh: Sinkala 等人 (Sinkala 等人，2018) 开展了一项映射研究，旨在探究架构恢复技术在软件产品线（SPLs）中的应用。 该研究强调了将专为单一系统设计的方案应用于更复杂的软件产品线环境时所面临的挑战。 具体而言，研究指出了在处理共享资产和管理变异性方面的局限性。 研究结果表明，现有技术未能充分应对软件产品线中的架构退化问题，尤其是在那些由克隆或临时代码库演化而来并随时间积累技术债务的系统之中。

paragraphs.en: Baabad et al. ( Baabad et al., 2020 ) reviewed the architectural degradation in open-source software, identifying key contributing factors such as frequent modifications, rapid system evolution, and limited architectural awareness among developers. The study also highlights common indicators of degradation, including code smells and architectural smells, and emphasizes the need for more research to better understand these causes and improve remediation strategies.
paragraphs.zh: Baabad 等人 (Baabad 等人，2020) 审查了开源软件中的架构退化问题，并识别出关键影响因素，例如频繁修改、系统快速演进以及开发人员对架构认识的不足。 该研究还指出了常见的退化指标，包括代码异味和架构异味，并强调需要开展更多研究，以更好地理解这些原因并改进修复策略。

paragraphs.en: Li et al. ( Li et al., 2021 ) conducted a survey to explore architectural erosion from a practitioner’s perspective. The study aims to understand how developers perceive, identify, and manage erosion in practice. The results indicate that architectural erosion is viewed as a structural issue affecting software quality, driven by both technical and organizational factors. Practitioners typically recognize erosion through its symptoms and attempt to mitigate its impact, although the study highlights the need for stronger empirical support for existing tools and techniques.
paragraphs.zh: Li 等人 (Li 等人，2021) 开展了一项调查，从从业者的视角探索架构侵蚀问题。 该研究旨在了解开发者在实践中如何感知、识别和管理侵蚀问题。 研究结果表明，架构侵蚀被视为影响软件质量的结构性问题，其成因既包括技术因素，也包括组织因素。 从业者通常通过侵蚀的症状来识别问题，并试图减轻其影响，但研究强调，现有工具和技术仍需更充分的实证支持。

paragraphs.en: Finally, Baabad et al. ( Baabad et al., 2022 ) presented a mapping study focusing on metrics for architectural degradation. The study categorizes existing metrics and demonstrates their role in identifying architectural decay. However, it also highlights the need for further investigation into how these metrics function and how effectively they capture different aspects of degradation.

paragraphs.en: Although previous secondary studies have examined architectural erosion, recovery techniques, degradation metrics, and practitioner perceptions, they generally address these dimensions separately. None provides an integrated synthesis connecting measurement approaches, metrics, tool support, and remediation strategies across the architectural degradation lifecycle. Our work addresses this gap through a multivocal literature review that combines academic and practitioner evidence and analyzes both the individual dimensions and their cross-dimensional relationships.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管以往的二次研究已经考察了架构侵蚀、恢复技术、退化指标以及从业者的看法，但这些研究通常分别处理这些维度。 没有任何一项研究能够提供一个整合性的综合分析，将测量方法、指标、工具支持以及修复策略在架构退化全生命周期中联系起来。 我们的研究通过一种多视角的文献综述来填补这一空白，该综述结合了学术和从业者的证据，并分析了各个维度及其跨维度的关系。

paragraphs.en: In summary, existing secondary studies provide valuable but largely dimension-specific views of architectural degradation. What remains missing is a synthesis that jointly examines how degradation is measured, which metrics operationalize it, which tools support its assessment, and which strategies are available for remediation. Our study addresses this gap by integrating these four dimensions and examining their relationships across the architectural degradation lifecycle.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，现有的二次研究为架构退化提供了宝贵但主要局限于特定维度的见解。 目前仍缺少一种综合性的分析，能够共同考察退化如何被衡量、哪些指标用于具体化这一过程、哪些工具支持其评估，以及有哪些可用策略可用于修复。 我们的研究通过整合这四种维度，并考察它们在架构退化全生命周期中的相互关系，从而填补了这一空白。

paragraphs.en: The purpose of this study is to investigate the phenomenon of architectural degradation and identify the approaches to measure and remediate architectural degradation. Therefore, we conducted a multivocal literature review supported by Large Language Models. Based on the objectives of our study, we defined the following Research Questions (RQs).
paragraphs.zh: 本研究旨在探究建筑退化现象，并确定衡量和修复建筑退化的方法。 因此，我们在大型语言模型的支持下，开展了一次多视角的文献综述。 基于我们研究的目标，我们定义了以下研究问题（RQs）。

sents.en: The purpose of this study is to investigate the phenomenon of architectural degradation and identify the approaches to measure and remediate architectural degradation.
sents.zh: 本研究旨在探究建筑退化现象，并确定衡量和修复建筑退化的方法。

sents.en: Therefore, we conducted a multivocal literature review supported by Large Language Models.
sents.zh: 因此，我们在大型语言模型的支持下，开展了一次多视角的文献综述。

sents.en: Based on the objectives of our study, we defined the following Research Questions (RQs).
sents.zh: 基于我们研究的目标，我们定义了以下研究问题（RQs）。

paragraphs.en: The purpose of RQ 1 is to explore the different methods that have been proposed or developed to measure software architectural degradation. Architectural degradation has been investigated through a broad range of approaches, including metric-based analyses, architecture conformance checking, smell detection, dependency analysis, graph-based techniques, and machine learning methods. However, these approaches have been proposed independently, making it difficult to obtain a comprehensive view of the available solutions and their characteristics. This analysis provides researchers and practitioners with a consolidated overview of the current state of the art and reveals areas requiring further methodological advances.
paragraphs.zh: RQ 1 的目的是探索为衡量软件架构退化而提出或开发的多种方法。 架构退化已通过多种方法进行了研究，包括基于指标的分析、架构合规性检查、异味检测、依赖分析、基于图的技术以及机器学习方法。 然而，这些方法都是独立提出的，因此很难对现有解决方案及其特性形成全面的认识。 这项分析为研究人员和实践者提供了当前技术水平的综合概览，并揭示了需要进一步方法论进步的研究领域。

sents.en: The purpose of RQ 1 is to explore the different methods that have been proposed or developed to measure software architectural degradation.
sents.zh: RQ 1 的目的是探索为衡量软件架构退化而提出或开发的多种方法。

sents.en: Architectural degradation has been investigated through a broad range of approaches, including metric-based analyses, architecture conformance checking, smell detection, dependency analysis, graph-based techniques, and machine learning methods.
sents.zh: 架构退化已通过多种方法进行了研究，包括基于指标的分析、架构合规性检查、异味检测、依赖分析、基于图的技术以及机器学习方法。

sents.zh: 然而，这些方法都是独立提出的，因此很难对现有解决方案及其特性形成全面的认识。

sents.en: This analysis provides researchers and practitioners with a consolidated overview of the current state of the art and reveals areas requiring further methodological advances.
sents.zh: 这项分析为研究人员和实践者提供了当前技术水平的综合概览，并揭示了需要进一步方法论进步的研究领域。

paragraphs.en: RQ 2 addresses the metrics used to assess software architectural degradation. Architectural degradation cannot be directly observed or quantified. Instead, existing studies rely on a variety of proxy metrics that capture structural properties, architectural symptoms, software evolution, and quality-related consequences. Despite the extensive body of research, there is currently no consolidated understanding of which metrics are adopted, which architectural dimensions they capture, or whether a common measurement framework has emerged. RQ 2 therefore aims to systematically identify and classify the metrics used to assess architectural degradation, providing a comprehensive overview of the architectural properties they measure and highlighting opportunities for more standardized measurement frameworks. RQ 2 aims to systematically identify and classify the metrics used to assess architectural degradation, providing a comprehensive overview of the architectural properties they measure. This analysis highlights inconsistencies, underexplored dimensions, and opportunities for developing more standardized and comprehensive measurement frameworks.
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题 2 探讨了用于评估软件架构退化程度的指标。 架构退化无法被直接观察或量化。 相反，现有研究依赖多种代理指标来捕捉结构特性、架构症状、软件演化以及与质量相关的后果。 尽管已有大量相关研究，但目前尚未形成统一的认识：即哪些指标被采用、它们捕捉了哪些架构维度，或者是否已经出现通用的测量框架。 因此，研究问题 2 旨在系统性地识别和分类用于评估架构退化的指标，全面概述这些指标所测量的架构特性，并指出构建更标准化测量框架的可能性。 研究问题 2 旨在系统性地识别和分类用于评估架构退化的指标，全面概述这些指标所测量的架构特性。 这项分析揭示了现有方法中的一致性缺失、尚未充分探索的维度，以及开发更标准化、更全面测量框架的机会。

sents.en: RQ 2 addresses the metrics used to assess software architectural degradation.
sents.zh: 研究问题 2 探讨了用于评估软件架构退化程度的指标。

sents.en: Architectural degradation cannot be directly observed or quantified.
sents.zh: 架构退化无法被直接观察或量化。

sents.en: Instead, existing studies rely on a variety of proxy metrics that capture structural properties, architectural symptoms, software evolution, and quality-related consequences.
sents.zh: 相反，现有研究依赖多种代理指标来捕捉结构特性、架构症状、软件演化以及与质量相关的后果。

sents.en: Despite the extensive body of research, there is currently no consolidated understanding of which metrics are adopted, which architectural dimensions they capture, or whether a common measurement framework has emerged.
sents.zh: 尽管已有大量相关研究，但目前尚未形成统一的认识：即哪些指标被采用、它们捕捉了哪些架构维度，或者是否已经出现通用的测量框架。

sents.en: RQ 2 therefore aims to systematically identify and classify the metrics used to assess architectural degradation, providing a comprehensive overview of the architectural properties they measure and highlighting opportunities for more standardized measurement frameworks.
sents.zh: 因此，研究问题 2 旨在系统性地识别和分类用于评估架构退化的指标，全面概述这些指标所测量的架构特性，并指出构建更标准化测量框架的可能性。

sents.en: RQ 2 aims to systematically identify and classify the metrics used to assess architectural degradation, providing a comprehensive overview of the architectural properties they measure.
sents.zh: 研究问题 2 旨在系统性地识别和分类用于评估架构退化的指标，全面概述这些指标所测量的架构特性。

sents.en: This analysis highlights inconsistencies, underexplored dimensions, and opportunities for developing more standardized and comprehensive measurement frameworks.
sents.zh: 这项分析揭示了现有方法中的一致性缺失、尚未充分探索的维度，以及开发更标准化、更全面测量框架的机会。

paragraphs.en: The research question RQ 3 aims to find several tools and approaches by concentrating on these solutions, which can assist in measuring software architectural degradation and understanding how they address different aspects of architectural degradation. Although numerous techniques for detecting architectural degradation have been proposed, their practical adoption largely depends on the availability of supporting tools. Existing tools differ substantially in terms of supported analyses, automation capabilities, integration with development environments, scalability, and maintenance support. However, there is currently no comprehensive overview of the available tool ecosystem. RQ3 aims to identify and classify the tools proposed for assessing architectural degradation, analyzing their supported functionalities, underlying approaches, and level of automation. This provides practitioners with an overview of existing tool support while highlighting research opportunities for more integrated and continuously operating solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题 RQ 3 旨在通过聚焦这些解决方案，找到若干有助于衡量软件架构退化并理解它们如何应对架构退化不同方面的工具和方法。 尽管已提出多种检测架构退化的技术，但它们的实际采用在很大程度上取决于是否有相应的支持工具可用。 现有工具在支持的分析类型、自动化能力、与开发环境的集成性、可扩展性和维护支持方面存在显著差异。 然而，目前尚缺乏对可用工具生态系统的全面概述。 RQ3 旨在识别并分类用于评估架构退化的工具，分析其支持的功能、底层方法以及自动化程度。 这为从业者提供了现有工具支持的概览，同时凸显了开发更具集成性和持续运行能力的解决方案所存在的研究机会。

paragraphs.en: We need to systematically understand the approaches and techniques proposed in the literature that can help to remediate architectural degradation. Identifying and classifying approaches in RQ 4 can provide insights to solve the concern of architectural degradation. Moreover, by uncovering the gaps in current techniques and approaches, this research RQ 4 aims to direct future architectural sustainability research and development. Detecting architectural degradation represents only the first step toward preserving software architecture. Long-term software sustainability requires effective remediation strategies capable of preventing, mitigating, or repairing architectural degradation throughout the software lifecycle. Although numerous studies focus on degradation detection, considerably less attention has been devoted to remediation. RQ4 aims to systematically identify and classify the approaches proposed to remediate architectural degradation, including preventive, corrective, and continuous remediation techniques. By synthesizing existing solutions, this research question highlights current limitations and identifies research gaps toward proactive and automated architectural sustainability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们需要系统地理解文献中提出的、有助于修复架构退化问题的方法和技术。 在研究问题 4 中识别和分类相关方法，可以为解决架构退化问题提供见解。 此外，通过揭示当前技术和方法的不足，本研究的研究问题 4 旨在指导未来软件架构可持续性的研究与开发。 检测架构退化只是维护软件架构的第一步。 长期的软件可持续性需要有效的修复策略，能够在整个软件生命周期中预防、缓解或修复架构退化。 尽管许多研究关注退化检测，但用于修复的研究却少得多。 研究问题 4 旨在系统地识别和分类为修复架构退化而提出的方法，包括预防性、纠正性和持续修复技术。 通过综合现有解决方案，本研究问题揭示了当前的局限性，并指出了实现主动且自动化的架构可持续性方面的研究空白。

paragraphs.en: All the steps were performed within a secure environment of the university’s supercomputer locally. We didn’t use any cloud services or external API’s. PDFs documents were utilized only for inference and were not used to fine-tune or train any model. In addition, all downloaded PDFs were removed after processing, and each job was operated in an isolated environment without persistent storage, guaranteeing that no data remained on the system after completion.
paragraphs.zh: 所有步骤均在大学超级计算机的本地安全环境中执行。 我们没有使用任何云服务或外部 API。 PDF 文档仅用于推理，未用于微调或训练任何模型。 此外，所有下载的 PDF 在处理完成后均被删除，且每个任务都在无持久存储的隔离环境中运行，确保任务完成后系统上不会残留任何数据。

paragraphs.en: To identify peer-reviewed studies, we selected a set of well-established bibliographic databases based on the guidelines proposed by Kitchenham and Charters ( Kitchenham and Brereton, 2013 ) . These sources are widely regarded as representative of the software engineering research community and have been extensively utilized in previous secondary studies. Accordingly, the selected databases included Scopus , Springer Nature , Web of Science (WoS) , IEEE Xplore , and the ACM Digital Library . To complement the academic literature with gray literature, data were collected from several web-based sources, including Yahoo , Bing , Google , Google Scholar (for non-peer-reviewed publications), and Stack Overflow . These platforms were chosen because they provide access to practitioner knowledge, industrial experiences, technical reports, blogs, and other forms of gray literature that may not be indexed in traditional academic databases. Their use is consistent with established guidelines for conducting Multivocal Literature Reviews (MLRs) ( Garousi et al., 2019 ) . For example, Janes et al. ( Janes et al., 2022 ) employed general-purpose search engines and practitioner-oriented platforms such as Stack Overflow to supplement academic evidence in their systematic gray literature review on microservices.
paragraphs.zh: 为了识别经过同行评审的研究，我们根据 Kitchenham 和 Charters（Kitchenham 和 Brereton，2013）提出的指南，选择了一系列久经验证的文献数据库。 这些资源被广泛视为软件工程研究界的代表，并且在以往的二次研究中得到了广泛应用。 因此，所选的数据库包括 Scopus、Springer Nature、Web of Science（WoS）、IEEE Xplore 和 ACM Digital Library。 为了用灰色文献补充学术文献，我们从多个网络来源收集了数据，包括 Yahoo、Bing、Google、Google Scholar（用于非同行评审出版物）以及 Stack Overflow。 选择这些平台是因为它们提供了获取从业者知识、工业经验、技术报告、博客以及其他形式灰色文献的途径，而这些内容可能无法在传统学术数据库中被索引。 使用这些资源符合开展多源文献综述（MLRs）的既定指南（Garousi 等，2019）。 例如，Janes 等人 （Janes 等，2022）在他们对微服务的系统性灰色文献综述中，使用了通用搜索引擎和面向从业者的平台（如 Stack Overflow）来补充学术证据。

paragraphs.en: The search and study selection process was conducted in January 2026 and covered all publications accessible at that time (Table 6 ). The execution of the search strategy resulted in 8672 retrieved peer-reviewed and grey articles. After removing duplicates, we obtained 7263 unique articles, comprising 6413 peer-reviewed and 850 gray.

paragraphs.en: To facilitate and accelerate the screening process, we used a local reasoning model (LRM) and incorporated the inclusion criteria directly into the prompting strategy. Studies were considered relevant when their titles or abstracts contained terms corresponding to the defined search string. The outputs generated by the LRM were subsequently verified using three independent large language models (LLMs) and further reviewed by the researchers to ensure consistency and reliability.
paragraphs.zh: 为了促进并加快筛选过程，我们使用了一个本地推理模型（LRM），并将纳入标准直接整合到了提示策略中。 当研究的标题或摘要中包含与已定义搜索字符串相对应的术语时，该研究即被视为相关。 LRM 生成的输出随后通过三个独立的大型语言模型（LLM）进行了验证，并由研究人员进一步审查，以确保一致性和可靠性。

sents.en: To facilitate and accelerate the screening process, we used a local reasoning model (LRM) and incorporated the inclusion criteria directly into the prompting strategy.
sents.zh: 为了促进并加快筛选过程，我们使用了一个本地推理模型（LRM），并将纳入标准直接整合到了提示策略中。

sents.en: Studies were considered relevant when their titles or abstracts contained terms corresponding to the defined search string.
sents.zh: 当研究的标题或摘要中包含与已定义搜索字符串相对应的术语时，该研究即被视为相关。

sents.en: The outputs generated by the LRM were subsequently verified using three independent large language models (LLMs) and further reviewed by the researchers to ensure consistency and reliability.
sents.zh: LRM 生成的输出随后通过三个独立的大型语言模型（LLM）进行了验证，并由研究人员进一步审查，以确保一致性和可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Following the initial screening phase, the full-text PDFs of the selected studies were provided to the LRM for systematic data extraction. To further improve the quality of the extracted information, our implementation integrated a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mechanism, enabling the model to retrieve and utilize relevant contextual evidence during the extraction process. Similarly to the title and abstract screening stage, the extracted data were first cross-validated using multiple LLMs and then examined by the humans. The complete set of prompts, scripts, and results is also available in the replication package 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 在初步筛选阶段结束后，我们将所选研究的全文 PDF 文件提供给 LRM，以进行系统化的数据提取。 为了进一步提升提取信息的质量，我们的实现整合了检索增强生成（RAG）机制，使模型能够在提取过程中检索并利用相关的上下文证据。 与标题和摘要的筛选阶段类似，提取的数据首先通过多个 LLM 进行交叉验证，然后由人工进行审查。 完整的提示词、脚本和结果也包含在复现包 2 中。

paragraphs.en: Testing the applicability of the inclusion and exclusion criteria. Before applying the inclusion and exclusion criteria, we conducted a pilot assessment on 20 randomly selected studies from the retrieved set, which were independently evaluated by three authors, following the recommendations of Kitchenham and Brereton (2013) .
paragraphs.zh: 测试纳入和排除标准的适用性。 在应用纳入和排除标准之前，我们对检索到的文献集中随机选取的 20 项研究进行了初步评估，三名作者根据 Kitchenham 和 Brereton（2013）的建议独立完成了评估。

paragraphs.en: Applying the inclusion and exclusion criteria to titles and abstracts. We applied the refined inclusion and exclusion criteria to their titles and abstracts using our automated script. This step filtered out clearly irrelevant studies while retaining potentially relevant ones for further assessment. As a result, 421 studies were selected for full-text review.
paragraphs.zh: 将纳入和排除标准应用于标题和摘要。 我们使用自动化脚本，将优化后的纳入和排除标准应用于这些文献的标题和摘要。 此步骤过滤掉了明显无关的研究，同时保留了可能相关的研究以供进一步评估。 因此，共有 421 项研究被选中进行全文审阅。

paragraphs.en: Full-text reading. We performed a full-text assessment of the 421 studies that passed the title and abstract screening. The full text of each study was analyzed using prompts designed to identify approaches related to software architecture degradation. Studies that did not report any relevant approach were excluded. Following this review, 284 studies were retained as Primary Studies (PS).
paragraphs.zh: 全文阅读。 我们对通过标题和摘要筛选的 421 项研究进行了全文阅读评估。 我们使用旨在识别与软件架构退化相关方法的提示词，对每项研究的全文进行了分析。 未报告任何相关方法的研究被排除在外。 经过此次审查，共有 284 项研究被保留为“主要研究”（PS）。

paragraphs.en: Quality and Assessment Criteria: Before proceeding with the review, we checked whether the quality of the selected articles was sufficient to support our goal and whether the quality of each article reached a certain quality level. To evaluate the selected peer-reviewed articles, we prepared a checklist according to the protocol proposed by Dybå and Dingsøyr ( Dybå and Dingsøyr, 2008 ) (Table 4 ) with a set of specific questions. We rank each answer, assigning a score on a five-point Likert scale (0=poor, 4=excellent). A paper satisfied the quality assessment criteria if it achieved a rating higher than (or equal to) 2. For the grey literature, we rely on the checklist proposed by the MLR guideline ( Garousi et al., 2019 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 质量与评估标准：在开始评审之前，我们检查了所选文章的质量是否足以支持我们的目标，以及每篇文章的质量是否达到了特定的水平。 为了评估所选的同行评审文章，我们根据 Dybå 和 Dingsøyr（Dybå and Dingsøyr, 2008）提出的方案（表 4），准备了一份包含一系列具体问题的检查清单。 我们对每个答案进行排序，在五点李克特量表上赋予分数（0=差，4=优秀）。 如果一篇论文获得的评分高于（或等于）2，则满足质量评估标准。 对于灰色文献，我们依赖 MLR 指南中提出的检查清单（Garousi et al., 2019）。

paragraphs.en: In empirical research, categorization and rating tasks were some of the most laborious and error-prone activities, frequently prone to inconsistencies, bias, and learning effects in human judgment, especially if conducted through large-scale manual coding ( Esposito et al., 2024b ; Esposito et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在实证研究中，分类和评级任务是最耗费精力且最容易出错的活动之一，这些活动常常容易受到人类判断中不一致性、偏见和学习效应的影响，尤其是在通过大规模人工编码进行时（Esposito et al., 2024b；Esposito et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: LRM/LLM are becoming more common and better at what they do, which has created new possibilities for people in Software Engineering (SE). They can now help with tasks that humans used to do accurately and efficiently. So, as an alternative to a manual, expert-driven coding and labeling procedure, we used LRM/LLM as judges to improve objectivity, scalability, and reproducibility.
paragraphs.zh: LRM/LLM 正变得越来越普遍，并且在其功能上表现得更出色，这为软件工程（SE）领域的人们创造了新的可能性。 现在，它们可以帮助完成过去由人类准确且高效执行的任务。 因此，作为手动、专家主导的编码和标注流程的一种替代方案，我们使用 LRM/LLM 担任评判者，以提高客观性、可扩展性和可重复性。

paragraphs.en: The recent studies performed by ( Esposito et al., 2025 ) , ( Robredo et al., 2025 ) , ( Su et al., 2026a ) show that LLMs can help practitioners and researchers with encouraging levels of dependability across a wide range of software engineering tasks, such as classification, summarization, and decision-making.
paragraphs.zh: 最近由 (Esposito et al., 2025)、(Robredo et al., 2025) 和 (Su et al., 2026a) 开展的研究表明，大型语言模型（LLM）能够在广泛的软件工程任务中，以令人鼓舞的可靠性水平为从业者和研究人员提供帮助，例如分类、摘要生成和决策。

paragraphs.en: Previous studies synthesizing evidence ( silva2012controlling ) on architectural degradation have predominantly relied on manual coding, keyword-based techniques, or predefined taxonomies, approaches that can become increasingly resource-intensive when applied to large and heterogeneous bodies of literature ( Li et al., 2021 ; li2022understanding ) .
paragraphs.zh: 先前整合文献证据（silva2012controlling）以研究架构退化问题的研究，主要依赖人工编码、基于关键词的技术或预定义分类法；然而，当这些方法应用于大规模且异质的文献集合时，所需资源会日益庞大（Li et al., 2021; li2022understanding）。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, our approach, successfully applied in similar tasks ( Robredo et al., 2025 ; Su et al., 2026a ; Su et al., 2026b ) integrates LLM-based semantic extraction with multi-model cross-validation and human adjudication, enabling the systematic analysis of a large and heterogeneous corpus of academic and gray literature. This pipeline supports the extraction and classification of measurement approaches, metrics, tools, and remediation strategies at scale while preserving human oversight throughout the process. Importantly, our aim is not to replace established empirical review methods, but to support their application at a larger scale while maintaining methodological rigor and traceability.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，我们的方法已成功应用于类似任务（Robredo 等人，2025；Su 等人，2026a；Su 等人，2026b），它将基于大型语言模型（LLM）的语义提取与多模型交叉验证及人工裁定相结合，从而能够系统性地分析规模庞大且异质性强的学术文献与灰色文献语料库。 该流程支持大规模地提取和分类测量方法、指标、工具及修复策略，同时在整个过程中保留人工监督。 重要的是，我们的目标并非取代成熟的实证综述方法，而是支持其在更大规模上的应用，同时保持方法论的严谨性和可追溯性。

paragraphs.en: In our study, we analyzed peer-reviewed and grey literature on software architectural degradation and extracted information on measurement approaches, metrics, supporting tools, and remediation strategies. Our methodology followed five main steps:

sents.zh: 在我们的研究中，我们分析了关于软件架构退化的同行评审文献和灰色文献，并提取了有关测量方法、指标、支持工具和修复策略的信息。

sents.en: Our methodology followed five main steps:
sents.zh: 我们的方法遵循五个主要步骤：

paragraphs.en: Using a large reasoning model to make a decision about papers inclusion and data extraction;
paragraphs.zh: 使用大型推理模型来决定论文是否纳入以及如何进行数据提取；

paragraphs.en: Validation of the output with three LLMs and human validation;
paragraphs.zh: 使用三种大型语言模型和人工验证对输出进行验证；

paragraphs.en: Categorize the extracted data from the papers by using LLM;
paragraphs.zh: 使用 LLM 对从论文中提取的数据进行分类；

paragraphs.en: Analyze co-occurrence patterns and map relationships
paragraphs.zh: 分析共现模式并绘制关系图

paragraphs.en: We assigned a unique role to each model based on its responsibility in the data analysis pipeline as follows (Table 7 ):
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据每个模型在数据分析流程中的职责，为其分配了唯一的角色，具体如下（表 7）：

paragraphs.en: Large Reasoning Model (LRM): Marco-o1 is responsible to extract the required information. For each prompt, it receives input data (e.g., title/abstract, full paper), it makes decision first of all about title and abstract selection and then full read the selected papers and later on classifies the data into categories, and provides information. Its output formed the basis for further verification and was referred to as LRM responses throughout the study.
paragraphs.zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）：Marco-o1 负责提取所需信息。 对于每个提示，它会接收输入数据（例如，标题/摘要、完整论文），首先对标题和摘要的选择做出决策，然后阅读所选的完整论文，接着将数据分类，并提供信息。 其输出构成了进一步验证的基础，并在整个研究中被称为 LRM 响应。

paragraphs.en: We applied prompt engineering strategies to steer LRM/LLM in classifying approaches to measure and remediate software architectural degradation. Prior research indicates that in-context learning via chat-based prompting can achieve performance comparable to or exceeding that of fine-tuning, while avoiding its higher computational cost ( Esposito et al., 2024a ) . In our setup, each prompt comprised two elements: a system message , which defined the assistant’s role and specified the required output structure, and a user message , which supplied the contextual input (e.g title/abstract). sents.en: Prior research indicates that in-context learning via chat-based prompting can achieve performance comparable to or exceeding that of fine-tuning, while avoiding its higher computational cost ( Esposito et al., 2024a ) .
sents.zh: 先前的研究表明，通过基于聊天的提示进行上下文学习，其性能可与微调相媲美甚至超越微调，同时避免了微调更高的计算成本（Esposito 等，2024a）。

sents.en: In our setup, each prompt comprised two elements: a system message , which defined the assistant’s role and specified the required output structure, and a user message , which supplied the contextual input (e.g title/abstract).
sents.zh: 在我们的设置中，每个提示包含两个要素：一个系统消息，用于定义助理的角色并指定所需的输出结构；以及一个用户消息，用于提供上下文输入（例如标题/摘要）。

sents.en: The model was instructed to produce a structured JSON output including:
sents.zh: 模型被要求生成一个结构化 JSON 输出，包括：

paragraphs.en: We employed a few-shot learning approach combined with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting ( Wei et al., 2022 ) to encourage more transparent and accurate classification.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用了一种少样本学习方法，并结合了思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）提示技术（Wei 等人，2022），以促进更透明、更准确的分类。

paragraphs.en: We implemented a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mechanism into our pipeline for both full-document processing. RAG enhances the model’s input with relevant external knowledge by retrieving semantically similar, previously labeled instances from the dataset using embedding-based similarity search. In our case, scientific PDFs exceed typical model context limits, each document was first converted into text, segmented into overlapping chunks, and indexed using embedding-based similarity search (FAISS). The model was then instructed to generate a structured JSON output containing one concise answer per category. This approach enables efficient processing of long documents while ensuring that classification decisions are evidence-based, context-aware, and less prone to hallucination.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在流程中实现了一种检索增强生成（RAG）机制，用于全文处理。 RAG 通过基于嵌入的相似性搜索，从数据集中检索语义相似的已标注实例，从而为模型输入补充相关的外部知识。 在我们的案例中，科学类 PDF 文件超出了典型模型的上下文限制，因此每份文档首先被转换为文本，分割成重叠的片段，并使用基于嵌入的相似性搜索（FAISS）进行索引。 随后，我们指导模型生成一个结构化的 JSON 输出，其中每个类别包含一个简洁的答案。 这种方法既能高效处理长文档，又能确保分类决策基于证据、考虑上下文，并减少幻觉的发生。

paragraphs.en: For executing this big scale analysis, we CSC’s Mahti supercomputer, using vLLM to serve the LRM/LLM for large-scale inference 1 1 1 http://csc.fi . Mahti is a high-performance computing platform intended for computationally and data-intensive research, providing more than 180,000 CPU cores connected through a fast interconnect network. Our jobs leveraged up to four NVIDIA A100 GPUs, ensuring high-speed and memory-efficient inference to process large volumes of data effectively. We employed deterministic decoding (temperature = 0, max_tokens = 1900) with a strict no-hallucination JSON prompt to ensure reproducible, evidence-grounded extraction and to minimize stochastic variability.
paragraphs.zh: 为执行这项大规模分析，我们使用了 CSC 的 Mahti 超级计算机，并通过 vLLM 为 LRM/LLM 提供服务以实现大规模推理 1 1 1 http://csc.fi 。 Mahti 是一个高性能计算平台，专为计算和数据密集型研究而设计，提供超过 180,000 个通过高速互连网络连接的 CPU 核心。 我们的任务最多利用了四块 NVIDIA A100 GPU，确保了高速且内存高效的推理，从而有效处理大量数据。 我们采用了确定性解码（温度 = 0，max_tokens = 1900），并结合了严格的无幻觉 JSON 提示词，以确保结果可重复、基于证据进行提取，并最大限度地减少随机性差异。

paragraphs.en: Since no previous study reported findings on the accuracy of LLMs for the task at hand, we designed a validation involving three human experts mimicking the LLM validator’s roles. The goal was to assess the quality and correctness of the model-generated outputs and to determine whether the validation models provided consistent judgments. Our validation followed a three-step protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 由于此前没有任何研究报道过大型语言模型（LLM）在本题任务中的准确性，我们设计了一项验证流程，由三名人类专家模拟 LLM 验证器的角色。 我们的目标是评估模型生成输出的质量和正确性，并判断这些验证模型能否提供一致的判断结果。 我们的验证遵循了一个包含三个步骤的流程。

sents.en: Since no previous study reported findings on the accuracy of LLMs for the task at hand, we designed a validation involving three human experts mimicking the LLM validator’s roles.
sents.zh: 由于此前没有任何研究报道过大型语言模型（LLM）在本题任务中的准确性，我们设计了一项验证流程，由三名人类专家模拟 LLM 验证器的角色。

sents.en: The goal was to assess the quality and correctness of the model-generated outputs and to determine whether the validation models provided consistent judgments.
sents.zh: 我们的目标是评估模型生成输出的质量和正确性，并判断这些验证模型能否提供一致的判断结果。

sents.en: Our validation followed a three-step protocol.
sents.zh: 我们的验证遵循了一个包含三个步骤的流程。

paragraphs.en: One expert independently reviewed the same input provided to the LRM and the three validation models (V1–V3), and manually evaluated the correctness of each model’s motivation. For each case, the expert indicated whether they agreed or disagreed with the LRM’s motivation, noted the majority decision among the validation models, and identified the models they considered correct.
paragraphs.zh: 一位专家独立审查了提供给 LRM 和三个验证模型（V1–V3）的相同输入，并手动评估了每个模型动机是否正确。 对于每个案例，该专家表明是否同意 LRM 的动机，记录了验证模型中的多数决策，并指出了他们认为正确的模型。

sents.en: One expert independently reviewed the same input provided to the LRM and the three validation models (V1–V3), and manually evaluated the correctness of each model’s motivation.
sents.zh: 一位专家独立审查了提供给 LRM 和三个验证模型（V1–V3）的相同输入，并手动评估了每个模型动机是否正确。

sents.en: For each case, the expert indicated whether they agreed or disagreed with the LRM’s motivation, noted the majority decision among the validation models, and identified the models they considered correct.
sents.zh: 对于每个案例，该专家表明是否同意 LRM 的动机，记录了验证模型中的多数决策，并指出了他们认为正确的模型。

paragraphs.en: A second expert repeated the same evaluation independently and documented their level of agreement with the first expert’s judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 另一位专家独立地重复了相同的评估，并记录了他们与第一位专家判断的一致性程度。

paragraphs.en: In cases of disagreement between the first two reviewers, a third expert was brought in to independently assess the same outputs. Final decisions were made through majority voting among the three validators.
paragraphs.zh: 如果前两位评审员之间存在分歧，则会引入第三位专家，对相同的输出结果进行独立评估。 最终决定由三位验证员通过多数投票作出。

sents.zh: 如果前两位评审员之间存在分歧，则会引入第三位专家，对相同的输出结果进行独立评估。

sents.en: Final decisions were made through majority voting among the three validators.
sents.zh: 最终决定由三位验证员通过多数投票作出。

paragraphs.en: After identifying the primary studies, we designed a structured data extraction form to ensure that all information required to answer the research questions was collected consistently across studies. The extracted fields were defined before the extraction process and were directly mapped to the research questions. Table 8 summarizes the extracted data items, their purpose, and their relationship with each research question.
paragraphs.zh: 在确定主要研究后，我们设计了一份结构化的数据提取表，以确保所有用于回答研究问题的信息都能在各研究中保持一致地收集。 在提取过程开始前，我们就定义了需要提取的字段，并将其直接对应到各个研究问题。 表 8 总结了所提取的数据项、其用途以及与每个研究问题的关系。

sents.en: The extracted fields were defined before the extraction process and were directly mapped to the research questions.
sents.zh: 在提取过程开始前，我们就定义了需要提取的字段，并将其直接对应到各个研究问题。

sents.en: Table 8 summarizes the extracted data items, their purpose, and their relationship with each research question.
sents.zh: 表 8 总结了所提取的数据项、其用途以及与每个研究问题的关系。

paragraphs.en: Each primary study was processed using the LRM/LLM-based extraction pipeline (Section 3.3 ). The full text of each paper was provided to the LRM together with prompts specifically designed to extract the information required for the review. The LRM generated structured JSON outputs containing the extracted information, which were automatically converted into CSV files to facilitate subsequent analysis. To improve the reliability of the extracted data, the generated outputs were validated using the multi-model validation process (Section 3.3 ). Whenever inconsistencies or low-confidence extractions were detected, the corresponding studies were manually inspected and the extracted information was corrected accordingly. As summarized in Table 8 , we extracted information regarding measurement approaches, architectural degradation metrics, supporting tools, and remediation strategies. This structured extraction allowed a consistent comparison across the primary studies and provided the evidence base for the thematic coding and synthesis. Finally, all extracted data were stored in a structured repository, maintaining traceability between each extracted element and its corresponding primary study, thus facilitating the reproducibility and auditability of the review process.
paragraphs.zh: 每篇主要研究均通过基于 LRM/LLM 的信息提取流程（第 3.3 节）进行处理。 每篇论文的全文均提供给 LRM，并附上专门设计用于提取综述所需信息的提示词。 LRM 生成了包含所提取信息的结构化 JSON 输出，这些输出被自动转换为 CSV 文件，以方便后续分析。 为提高提取数据的可靠性，生成的输出通过多模型验证流程（第 3.3 节）进行了验证。 每当检测到不一致或置信度较低的信息提取结果时，都会对相应研究进行人工检查，并据此修正所提取的信息。 如表 8 所示，我们提取了有关测量方法、架构退化指标、支持工具以及修复策略的信息。 这种结构化提取使得主要研究之间能够进行一致的比较，并为主题编码与综合分析提供了证据基础。 最后，所有提取的数据均存储于一个结构化仓库中，保持了每个提取元素与其对应主要研究之间的可追溯性，从而确保了综述过程的可重复性与可审计性。

paragraphs.en: To support the verifiability and replication of our study, we provide a replication package 2 2 2 containing the complete search protocol, inclusion and exclusion criteria, prompts, LLM configurations, processing scripts, extracted data, classification outputs, and analysis results. The package preserves traceability between the extracted evidence and the corresponding primary studies, enabling independent inspection of the review process and reproduction of the analyses reported in this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持我们研究的可验证性和可重复性，我们提供了一个包含完整搜索方案、纳入与排除标准、提示词、大型语言模型配置、处理脚本、提取数据、分类结果和分析结果的复现包。 该复现包保留了所提取证据与相应原始研究之间的可追溯性，从而能够独立审查评审过程，并重现本文报告的分析结果。

paragraphs.en: For each table (Tables 10 – 13 ), the first column ( Category ) reports the high-level category together with the number and percentage of primary studies mentioning that category. The second column ( Subcategory ) reports the corresponding subcategories derived through the LLM-supported thematic/axial coding process (Section 3.3 ). The third ( #PS ) and fourth ( %PS ) columns indicate, respectively, the number and percentage of primary studies mentioning each subcategory. Since a single primary study may contribute to multiple categories or subcategories, the #PS values are non-exclusive and therefore do not necessarily sum to the total number of primary studies. Finally, the last column reports the number of distinct approaches, metrics, tools, or remediation techniques identified within each subcategory. For each research question, we first present the overall distribution of the identified categories and then discuss the three most frequently reported categories together with the least represented one. This organization highlights both the dominant research directions and the areas that have received comparatively limited attention.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个表格（表 10–13），第一列（类别）报告了高级类别，以及提及该类别的主要研究的数量和百分比。 第二列（子类别）报告了通过 LLM 支持的主题/轴向编码过程（第 3.3 节）得出的相应子类别。 第三列（#PS）和第四列（%PS）分别表示提及每个子类别的主要研究的数量和百分比。 由于一项主要研究可能涉及多个类别或子类别，因此 #PS 值并非互斥的，所以其总和不一定等于主要研究的总数。 最后，最后一列报告了在每个子类别中识别出的不同方法、指标、工具或修复技术的数量。 对于每个研究问题，我们首先介绍已识别类别的总体分布，然后讨论报告频率最高的三个类别以及报告频率最低的类别。 这种组织方式既突出了主导的研究方向，也揭示了那些相对较少受到关注的领域。

paragraphs.en: We identified 277 techniques for measuring architectural degradation and grouped them into seven categories according to their underlying analysis strategy. Figure 3 and Table 10 show a clear concentration around static and code-centric assessment. Researchers rely primarily on approaches that inspect source code, structural dependencies, architectural rules, and measurable software properties without observing how the system evolves or behaves during execution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别出 277 种衡量架构退化程度的技术，并根据其底层分析策略将其分为七类。 图 3 和表 10 显示，评估方法明显集中在静态和以代码为中心的评估方式上。 研究人员主要依赖检查源代码、结构依赖关系、架构规则以及可测量的软件属性的方法，而不会观察系统在运行期间如何演变或表现。

sents.en: Figure 3 and Table 10 show a clear concentration around static and code-centric assessment.
sents.zh: 图 3 和表 10 显示，评估方法明显集中在静态和以代码为中心的评估方式上。

paragraphs.en: Static & Structural Analysis dominates the literature and appears in 56.7% of the primary studies. Together, these approaches inspect source code, analyze relationships among components, and represent the architecture through structural or dependency graphs to identify anomalies, undesirable configurations, and deviations from the intended design. Researchers frequently adopt these techniques because they scale to large systems, support repeatable analyses, and integrate naturally into continuous integration and quality assurance workflows.

paragraphs.en: At the opposite end, Evolutionary & Historical Analysis represents the smallest category and appears in only 12.0% of the studies refWL4, WL37: , WL38: , WL49: , WL259: , WL260: , GL268: . These approaches analyze version histories, architectural changes, and degradation patterns across releases to understand how architecture evolves over time. The difference between Static & Structural Analysis and Evolutionary & Historical Analysis approaches a factor of five. Although architectural degradation develops through continuous change, researchers still assess it mainly through structural properties observable in individual system snapshots.
paragraphs.zh: 在另一端，演化与历史分析代表最小的类别，仅出现在 12.0% 的研究中 refWL4, WL37: , WL38: , WL49: , WL259: , WL260: , GL268: 。 这些方法通过分析版本历史、架构变更以及各版本间的退化模式，来理解架构随时间的演化过程。 静态与结构分析方法和演化与历史分析方法之间的差异接近五倍。 尽管架构退化是持续变化的结果，但研究人员仍然主要通过单个系统快照中可观察到的结构属性来评估它。

paragraphs.en: We identified 357 metrics used to evaluate architectural degradation and grouped them into seven categories according to the architectural properties they capture. Figure 4 and Table 11 show a highly concentrated measurement landscape in which structural metrics dominate both the number of studies and the variety of identified items.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别出了用于评估架构退化的 357 项指标，并根据这些指标所反映的架构特性，将其归入七个类别。 图 4 和表 11 显示了一个高度集中的测量格局，其中结构指标在研究数量和研究中识别出的项目多样性方面均占据主导地位。

paragraphs.en: Structural Design Metrics appears in 92.3% of the primary studies. Nearly every study that quantifies architectural degradation uses at least one metric from this category, which makes structural measurement the common language of the field. Dependency and Modularity Metrics lead at 28.9% WL1: , WL3: , WL4: , WL5: , GL273: , GL278: and GL280: , followed by Coupling Metrics at 19.7% WL3: , WL4: , WL5: , WL262: , and WL266: , Size Metrics at 16.2% WL2: , WL4: , WL5: , WL9: , WL15: , GL278: , and GL280: , Complexity Metrics at 14.8% WL4: , WL5: , WL6: , WL7: , WL265: , GL271: , and Cohesion Metrics at 12.7% WL3: , WL19: , WL23: , WL32: , WL39: , WL45: , WL256: , WL258: , and WL262: . Together, these metrics characterize how software components interact, how responsibilities spread across modules, how complex individual elements become, and how closely the implementation respects modular boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 结构设计的指标出现在 92.3% 的主要研究中。 几乎所有量化架构退化的研究都至少使用了一个来自该类别的指标，这使得结构测量成为该领域的通用语言。 依赖性和模块化指标以 28.9% 的比例领先，涉及 WL1:、WL3:、WL4:、WL5:、GL273:、GL278: 和 GL280:；其次是耦合指标，占 19.7%，涉及 WL3:、WL4:、WL5:、WL262: 和 WL266:；规模指标占 16.2%，涉及 WL2:、WL4:、WL5:、WL9:、WL15:、GL278: 和 GL280:；复杂性指标占 14.8%，涉及 WL4:、WL5:、WL6:、WL7:、WL265:、GL271:；内聚指标占 12.7%，涉及 WL3:、WL19:、WL23:、WL32:、WL39:、WL45:、WL256:、WL258: 和 WL262:。 这些指标共同描述了软件组件如何相互作用、职责如何在模块间分布、单个元素如何变得复杂，以及实现过程在多大程度上遵循了模块化边界。

paragraphs.en: Quality & Maintainability Metrics forms the second-largest category and appears in 35.9% of the studies. Maintainability and Quality Metrics account for most of this category and appear in 32.4% of the studies WL1: , WL2: , WL4: , WL5: , WL7: , WL11: ,, GL280: , and GL281: . Documentation and Traceability Metrics reach only 2.5% WL12: , WL26: , WL80: , WL81: , WL98: , WL103: , WL118: , while Testability Metrics appear in 1.1% WL23: , WL215: , WL244: . Researchers therefore assess the quality-related consequences of degradation mainly through general maintainability indicators, while they devote considerably less attention to documentation quality, architectural traceability, and testability.
paragraphs.zh: 质量与可维护性指标构成第二大类别，出现在 35.9% 的研究中。 可维护性与质量指标占该类别的大多数，出现在 32.4% 的研究中 WL1: , WL2: , WL4: , WL5: , WL7: , WL11: ,, GL280: , 和 GL281: 。 文档与可追溯性指标仅占 2.5% WL12: , WL26: , WL80: , WL81: , WL98: , WL103: , WL118: ，而可测试性指标则出现在 1.1% 的研究中 WL23: , WL215: , WL244: 。 因此，研究人员主要通过通用的可维护性指标来评估性能退化对质量的影响，而对文档质量、架构可追溯性和可测试性的关注则少得多。

paragraphs.en: Degradation-Specific Indicators represent the third-largest category and appear in 27.8% of the studies. Architectural Smell Metrics account for 14.4% WL1: , WL4: , WL5: , WL7: , WL8: , WL19: , WL233: , WL235: , GL268: , GL280: , while Technical Debt Metrics account for 13.4% WL1: , WL2: , WL5: , WL6: , WL12: , WL23: , WL31: , GL273: , GL278: , and GL280: . These metrics directly operationalize concepts associated with architectural degradation, including recurring smells, accumulated debt, structural inconsistencies, and violations. Their presence shows that part of the literature has moved beyond general-purpose structural metrics and developed indicators that target degradation more explicitly.
paragraphs.zh: 退化特定指标是第三大类别，出现在 27.8% 的研究中。 架构异味指标占 14.4% WL1: , WL4: , WL5: , WL7: , WL8: , WL19: , WL233: , WL235: , GL268: , GL280: ，而技术债务指标占 13.4% WL1: , WL2: , WL5: , WL6: , WL12: , WL23: , WL31: , GL273: , GL278: , 和 GL280: 。 这些指标直接将与架构退化相关的概念转化为可操作的形式，包括重复出现的异味、累积的债务、结构不一致性和违规情况。 它们的存在表明，部分文献已经超越了通用结构指标，发展出更明确针对退化的指标。

paragraphs.en: At the opposite end, Auxiliary / Statistical Indicators represents the smallest category and appears in 12.7% of the studies. Researchers use these indicators to complement architectural measurements through statistical summaries, derived indices, and context-specific variables. Their limited presence further confirms that the literature prioritizes direct structural measurements over supporting statistical evidence and less conventional indicators.
paragraphs.zh: 在另一端，辅助/统计指标代表最小的类别，出现在 12.7% 的研究中。 研究人员利用这些指标通过统计摘要、衍生指数和特定情境的变量来补充建筑测量数据。 它们出现的频率较低，进一步证实了文献更重视直接的结构测量，而非辅助性的统计证据和较少采用的指标。

paragraphs.en: We classified the tools reported in the literature into seven categories according to their primary function in the degradation assessment process. Figure 5 and Table 12 show a mature ecosystem for detecting and analyzing degradation, together with extensive supporting infrastructure, but a considerably less developed ecosystem for assisting remediation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据文献中报道的工具在退化评估过程中的主要功能，将其分为七类。 图 5 和表 12 显示了一个成熟的退化检测与分析生态系统，以及广泛的支持性基础设施，但用于辅助修复的生态系统则发展得远为不足。

sents.en: Figure 5 and Table 12 show a mature ecosystem for detecting and analyzing degradation, together with extensive supporting infrastructure, but a considerably less developed ecosystem for assisting remediation.
sents.zh: 图 5 和表 12 显示了一个成熟的退化检测与分析生态系统，以及广泛的支持性基础设施，但用于辅助修复的生态系统则发展得远为不足。

paragraphs.en: Detection & Analysis Tools dominates the literature and appears in 63.0% of the primary studies. Static Analysis Tools account for 20.4% WL3: , WL5: , WL7: , WL10: , GL275: , GL280: , GL283: , while Dependency Analysis Tools account for 20.1% WL1: , WL5: , WL7: , WL9: , WL16: , GL273: , GL279: , GL280: . Graph-Based Tools follow at 10.2% WL1: , WL9: , WL33: , WL59: , WL68: , WL79: , WL103: , WL256: , and WL257: , Smell Detection Tools at 7.0% WL6: , WL21: , WL27: , WL33: , WL36: , WL39: , WL241: , GL269: , GL273: , and Clustering Tools at 5.3% WL3: , WL5: , WL9: , WL45: , WL54: , WL200: , WL235: , WL266: . Together, these tools inspect source code, identify structural dependencies, model architectural relationships, detect recurring anomalies, and group software elements according to their structural characteristics. The prevalence of these tools closely reflects the dominance of static and structural measurement approaches reported for RQ 1 .

paragraphs.en: We classified the remediation approaches into seven categories according to the level and timing of their intervention. paragraphs.en: Architectural degradation has attracted sustained research attention for more than two decades, resulting in a rich body of techniques for measuring, detecting, and mitigating architectural erosion. Previous secondary studies have shown that degradation emerges from a combination of technical and organizational factors and have documented a broad spectrum of approaches for detecting and addressing it ( Silva and Balasubramaniam, 2012 ; Li2022ArchitectureErosionSMS ) . The evidence synthesized in this review suggests that progress has not been uniform across the architectural degradation lifecycle. The literature has advanced considerably in understanding how degradation can be identified, whereas substantially less agreement exists on how it should be prevented, remediated, and continuously managed.
paragraphs.zh: 架构退化在过去二十多年中持续受到研究关注，由此形成了丰富的技术体系，用于测量、检测和缓解架构侵蚀。 以往的二次研究表明，架构退化源于技术因素和组织因素的共同作用，并记录了多种检测和应对该问题的方法（Silva and Balasubramaniam, 2012；Li2022ArchitectureErosionSMS）。 本综述综合的证据表明，在架构退化生命周期各阶段取得的进展并不均衡。 文献在理解如何识别架构退化方面已有显著进展，但在如何预防、修复和持续管理方面却存在较大分歧。

sents.en: Architectural degradation has attracted sustained research attention for more than two decades, resulting in a rich body of techniques for measuring, detecting, and mitigating architectural erosion.
sents.zh: 架构退化在过去二十多年中持续受到研究关注，由此形成了丰富的技术体系，用于测量、检测和缓解架构侵蚀。

sents.en: Previous secondary studies have shown that degradation emerges from a combination of technical and organizational factors and have documented a broad spectrum of approaches for detecting and addressing it ( Silva and Balasubramaniam, 2012 ; Li2022ArchitectureErosionSMS ) .
sents.zh: 以往的二次研究表明，架构退化源于技术因素和组织因素的共同作用，并记录了多种检测和应对该问题的方法（Silva and Balasubramaniam, 2012；Li2022ArchitectureErosionSMS）。

sents.en: The evidence synthesized in this review suggests that progress has not been uniform across the architectural degradation lifecycle.
sents.zh: 本综述综合的证据表明，在架构退化生命周期各阶段取得的进展并不均衡。

sents.en: The literature has advanced considerably in understanding how degradation can be identified, whereas substantially less agreement exists on how it should be prevented, remediated, and continuously managed.
sents.zh: 文献在理解如何识别架构退化方面已有显著进展，但在如何预防、修复和持续管理方面却存在较大分歧。

paragraphs.en: This imbalance appears consistently across all four research questions. Measurement approaches, metric families, and tooling exhibit a high degree of convergence, indicating that the community largely shares a common understanding of how architectural degradation should be assessed. In contrast, remediation strategies remain fragmented across technical, architectural, and organizational interventions, with no comparable consensus emerging. More than a decade ago, De Silva and Balasubramaniam argued that effectively controlling architectural erosion requires combining prevention, detection, and restoration strategies rather than relying on isolated technical solutions ( Silva and Balasubramaniam, 2012 ) . The evidence collected in this review suggests that this objective has not yet been fully achieved. While the literature provides a mature ecosystem of techniques for recognizing degradation, considerably less attention has been devoted to understanding how different remediation strategies should be selected, coordinated, and sustained over time.
paragraphs.zh: 这种失衡在所有四个研究问题中均持续存在。 测量方法、指标体系及工具展现出高度的一致性，表明该领域社区在如何评估架构退化方面基本达成了共同理解。 相比之下，修复策略在技术、架构和组织干预层面仍显得零散，尚未形成可比较的共识。 十多年前，De Silva 和 Balasubramaniam 指出，有效控制架构侵蚀需要将预防、检测和恢复策略相结合，而非依赖孤立的技术解决方案（Silva and Balasubramaniam, 2012）。 本次综述收集到的证据表明，这一目标尚未完全实现。 尽管现有文献已提供了一套成熟的退化识别技术体系，但针对如何选择、协调并长期维持不同修复策略的理解，却得到了相对较少的关注。

sents.en: This imbalance appears consistently across all four research questions.
sents.zh: 这种失衡在所有四个研究问题中均持续存在。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps the most consistent finding is the strong structural bias that characterizes the literature. Static & Structural Analysis dominates the measurement approaches, while Structural Design Metrics appear in more than 90% of the primary studies. This observation agrees with previous work showing that architectural degradation is primarily identified through structural symptoms, architectural anomalies, and conformance violations rather than runtime evidence ( Macia et al., 2012 ; Baabad et al., 2022 ) . Our results indicate that this predominance extends beyond the choice of metrics. Structural reasoning shapes the entire assessment process, influencing how degradation is measured, how evidence is collected, and how supporting tools are designed.
paragraphs.zh: 或许最一致的研究发现是，文献中普遍存在强烈的结构性偏见。 静态与结构分析在测量方法中占据主导地位，而结构设计指标则出现在超过90%的核心研究中。 这一观察结果与先前的研究一致，这些研究表明，架构退化主要通过结构性症状、架构异常和合规性违反来识别，而非通过运行时证据（Macia等，2012；Baabad等，2022）。 我们的研究结果表明，这种主导地位不仅体现在指标的选择上。 结构性推理塑造了整个评估过程，影响着退化状态的测量方式、证据的收集方法以及辅助工具的设计。

paragraphs.en: By comparison, relatively few studies investigate degradation through system execution. Dynamic analysis, runtime metrics, and runtime-aware remediation remain markedly underrepresented. This imbalance is understandable because structural artifacts are easier to collect, deterministic to analyze, and supported by mature tooling. However, architectural degradation is inherently an evolutionary phenomenon. It emerges through continuous software evolution, changing requirements, operational pressures, and accumulated design decisions rather than from static structure alone. Consequently, assessment approaches centred primarily on structural evidence are likely to identify degradation only after its effects have already materialized within the implemented architecture. This predominance of structural assessment contrasts with the broader view that architectural quality should be continuously preserved throughout software evolution rather than periodically evaluated ( Koziolek, 2011 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，通过系统执行研究性能退化的相关研究相对较少。 动态分析、运行时指标以及运行时感知的修复措施明显未被充分关注。 这种失衡可以理解，因为结构特征更容易收集、更易于确定性地分析，并且有成熟的工具支持。 然而，架构退化本质上是一种演化现象。 它源于持续的软件演化、需求变化、运行压力以及累积的设计决策，而不仅仅是静态结构本身。 因此，主要依赖结构证据的评估方法很可能只有在退化效应已在已部署的架构中显现之后，才能识别出退化问题。 这种对结构评估的过度依赖，与更广泛的观点形成对比：架构质量应在整个软件演化过程中持续保持，而非仅进行周期性评估（Koziolek, 2011）。

paragraphs.en: This interpretation also complements the observations of Li et al. ( Li2022ArchitectureErosionSMS ) , who argue that architectural erosion should not be viewed solely as a structural phenomenon but also as the result of organizational and evolutionary processes. While the literature increasingly acknowledges these broader causes, the methods used to assess degradation remain overwhelmingly centred on structural properties. The evidence therefore reveals a disconnect between how architectural degradation is conceptualized and how it is empirically investigated.
paragraphs.zh: 这种解释也补充了 Li 等人（Li et al.）的观察结果。 （Li2022ArchitectureErosionSMS）认为，建筑结构的侵蚀不应仅被视为一种结构现象，而也应看作是组织与演化过程的结果。 尽管相关文献日益承认这些更广泛的原因，但用于评估退化程度的方法仍然主要集中于结构特性。 因此，这些证据揭示了建筑退化在概念化方式与实证研究方式之间的脱节。

paragraphs.en: The end-to-end paths reported in Figure 2 reinforce this interpretation. The most informative observation is not that the dominant path represents only 18 studies, but that nearly all dominant paths follow the same sequence of static analysis, structural metrics, and detection tools before diverging during remediation. This remarkable stability indicates that methodological diversity is concentrated almost entirely after degradation has been identified. In other words, the community has largely converged on how degradation should be observed, while substantially different views remain on how corrective actions should be designed, prioritized, and combined.
paragraphs.zh: 图2中报告的全局路径支持这一解释。 最具启发性的观察并非主导路径仅涵盖18项研究，而是几乎所有主导路径在修复阶段分叉之前，都遵循相同的静态分析、结构指标和检测工具的顺序。 这种显著的一致性表明，方法论上的多样性几乎完全集中在退化问题被识别之后。 换言之，该领域在如何观察退化问题上已基本达成共识，但在如何设计、排序和组合纠正措施方面仍存在显著不同的观点。

sents.zh: 换言之，该领域在如何观察退化问题上已基本达成共识，但在如何设计、排序和组合纠正措施方面仍存在显著不同的观点。

paragraphs.en: This pattern also clarifies the conclusions of previous secondary studies. De Silva and Balasubramaniam organized the literature into complementary prevention, detection, and restoration strategies ( Silva and Balasubramaniam, 2012 ) , whereas Li et al. highlighted the broad spectrum of techniques proposed to detect and address architectural erosion ( Li et al., 2022 ) . The evidence synthesized here suggests that this diversity is not uniformly distributed across the degradation lifecycle. Instead, it emerges primarily after degradation has been diagnosed. Before that point, the literature exhibits a remarkably stable methodological pipeline centred on structural assessment. The principal challenge therefore appears to have shifted from improving degradation detection toward understanding how different remediation strategies should interact to preserve architectural integrity throughout software evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 这一模式也阐明了先前二次研究的结论。 De Silva 和 Balasubramaniam 将文献整理为互补的预防、检测和恢复策略（Silva 和 Balasubramaniam，2012），而 Li 等人则强调了为检测和处理架构侵蚀而提出的广泛技术（Li 等人，2022）。 此处综合的证据表明，这种多样性并未在整个退化生命周期中均匀分布。 相反，它主要是在退化被诊断出来之后才出现。 在此之前，文献显示存在一个以结构评估为核心的、方法上相当稳定的流程。 因此，主要挑战似乎已从改进退化检测转向理解不同的修复策略应如何相互作用，以在整个软件演化过程中保持架构的完整性。

paragraphs.en: A second concern emerging from the findings is the clear imbalance between diagnosis and intervention . The literature provides a rich ecosystem of approaches for identifying architectural degradation, including structural metrics, rule checking, smell detection, and dedicated analysis tools. By contrast, considerably fewer studies investigate how degradation should be addressed once it has been detected. This imbalance is particularly evident in the tooling landscape, where Detection & Analysis Tools largely outnumber Remediation-Support Tools. The evidence therefore suggests that the community has invested substantially more effort in answering the question “Is the architecture degrading?” than “What should be done next?”
paragraphs.zh: 研究结果揭示的第二个问题是诊断与干预之间明显的不平衡。 现有文献为识别架构退化提供了丰富的方法体系，包括结构指标、规则检查、气味检测以及专门的分析工具。 相比之下，研究如何针对已检测到的退化问题采取应对措施的论文则少得多。 这种不平衡在工具生态中尤为明显：检测与分析工具的数量远多于修复支持工具。 因此，证据表明，该领域社区在回答“架构是否正在退化？”这一问题上的投入，远超过对“接下来应该怎么做？”这一问题的投入。

paragraphs.en: The remediation landscape reveals an additional level of fragmentation. Code-Level Repair, Architecture-Level Repair, and Process & Organizational Remediation all receive substantial attention, yet they are rarely investigated as complementary components of the same intervention strategy. Most studies focus on one level of action while treating the others as external concerns. However, architectural degradation rarely originates from a single cause. It accumulates through design decisions, implementation shortcuts, evolving requirements, and organizational constraints acting simultaneously. This observation closely resembles the challenges discussed in the Architectural Technical Debt literature, where long-term architectural quality depends on continuously managing the consequences of local design decisions rather than periodically correcting accumulated problems ( Kruchten et al., 2012 ; Nord et al., 2012 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 修复格局揭示了另一个层面的碎片化。 代码级修复、架构级修复以及流程与组织修复都受到了广泛关注，但它们很少被研究为同一干预策略中相互补充的组成部分。 大多数研究只关注单一行动层面，而将其他层面视为外部问题。 然而，架构退化很少源于单一原因。 它是设计决策、实现捷径、不断变化的需求以及组织约束同时作用的结果。 这一观察结果与“架构技术债务”文献中讨论的挑战非常相似：长期架构质量取决于持续管理局部设计决策所带来的后果，而非周期性地纠正累积的问题（Kruchten et al., 2012；Nord et al., 2012）。

sents.en: This observation closely resembles the challenges discussed in the Architectural Technical Debt literature, where long-term architectural quality depends on continuously managing the consequences of local design decisions rather than periodically correcting accumulated problems ( Kruchten et al., 2012 ; Nord et al., 2012 ) .
sents.zh: 这一观察结果与“架构技术债务”文献中讨论的挑战非常相似：长期架构质量取决于持续管理局部设计决策所带来的后果，而非周期性地纠正累积的问题（Kruchten et al., 2012；Nord et al., 2012）。

paragraphs.en: The unexpectedly high presence of Recovery & Reverse-Engineering tools reinforces this interpretation. Rather than preventing degradation during software evolution, a considerable portion of the literature concentrates on reconstructing architectural knowledge after it has already been lost. Similar observations motivated previous work on architecture-preserving refactorings, where architectural recovery is viewed as a prerequisite for restoring architectural integrity rather than preventing degradation in the first place ( Terra et al., 2012 ) . Together, these findings suggest that a significant part of the literature remains inherently reactive, addressing degradation after architectural knowledge has already deteriorated.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复与逆向工程工具出人意料地普遍存在，这一现象进一步支持了上述解释。 相较于在软件演化过程中防止架构退化，大量文献更关注在架构知识已经丢失之后如何重建其架构知识。 类似的观察结果也启发了此前关于保留架构重构的研究，其中，架构恢复被视为恢复架构完整性的前提条件，而非从一开始就防止架构退化（Terra 等人，2012）。 综合来看，这些发现表明，大量文献本质上仍属于被动应对型研究，即仅在架构知识已经恶化之后才开始解决退化问题。

sents.en: The unexpectedly high presence of Recovery & Reverse-Engineering tools reinforces this interpretation.
sents.zh: 恢复与逆向工程工具出人意料地普遍存在，这一现象进一步支持了上述解释。

paragraphs.en: Another notable observation concerns predictive approaches. Despite the increasing availability of software repositories, architectural histories, and development analytics, Machine Learning and Prediction remain among the least represented measurement approaches, while AI/ML-based tooling also occupies only a limited portion of the landscape. Rather than indicating a lack of interest in artificial intelligence, these results suggest that predictive architectural degradation remains an emerging research direction. Existing studies continue to rely predominantly on structural indicators and threshold-based reasoning, whereas comparatively little attention has been devoted to forecasting degradation trajectories before architectural symptoms become observable. This gap appears particularly significant considering that architectural degradation is inherently progressive and cumulative, making early intervention substantially more valuable than late diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个值得注意的观察点涉及预测方法。 尽管软件仓库、架构历史和开发分析数据日益丰富，但机器学习和预测仍然是应用最少的测量方法之一，而基于人工智能/机器学习的工具在整体格局中也仅占有限份额。 这些结果并非表明人们对人工智能缺乏兴趣，而是说明预测性架构退化研究仍是一个新兴的研究方向。 现有研究主要依赖结构指标和基于阈值的推理，而对在架构问题显现之前预测退化轨迹的关注则相对较少。 考虑到架构退化本质上具有渐进性和累积性，这一差距显得尤为显著，因为早期干预远比晚期诊断更具价值。

sents.zh: 另一个值得注意的观察点涉及预测方法。

paragraphs.en: We examined how the architectural degradation literature combines research attention , measured by the number of unique primary studies associated with each category, with technique diversity , measured by the number of distinct normalized approaches, metrics, tools, or remediation strategies. Tables 15 and 16 report the classification, while Figures 7 and 8 illustrate the distributions. Together, these measures describe the coverage and breadth of the literature, without directly establishing effectiveness, adoption, or methodological maturity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了建筑退化领域的文献如何将研究关注（通过每个类别关联的唯一原始研究数量来衡量）与技术多样性（通过不同标准化方法、指标、工具或修复策略的数量来衡量）结合起来。 表 15 和表 16 报告了分类情况，而图 7 和图 8 展示了分布情况。 这些指标共同描述了该文献的覆盖范围和广度，但并未直接证明其有效性、应用程度或方法上的成熟度。

sents.en: We examined how the architectural degradation literature combines research attention , measured by the number of unique primary studies associated with each category, with technique diversity , measured by the number of distinct normalized approaches, metrics, tools, or remediation strategies.
sents.zh: 我们研究了建筑退化领域的文献如何将研究关注（通过每个类别关联的唯一原始研究数量来衡量）与技术多样性（通过不同标准化方法、指标、工具或修复策略的数量来衡量）结合起来。

sents.en: Tables 15 and 16 report the classification, while Figures 7 and 8 illustrate the distributions.
sents.zh: 表 15 和表 16 报告了分类情况，而图 7 和图 8 展示了分布情况。

paragraphs.en: The concentration of approaches, metrics, and tools around structural assessment gives researchers several ways to examine dependencies, modular boundaries, and architectural violations. Far fewer approaches explicitly investigate how these properties change: the catalogue contains 78 static and structural approaches, compared with seven evolutionary and historical approaches. This difference highlights an opportunity to connect structural observations across successive versions and examine when architectural changes indicate deterioration. Static techniques can contribute to this investigation, provided that their application and interpretation account for the system’s evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 围绕结构评估的各种方法、指标和工具的高度集中，为研究人员提供了多种途径来考察依赖关系、模块化边界以及架构违规问题。 明确研究这些属性如何变化的方法要少得多：该目录包含 78 种静态和结构方法，而进化和历史方法仅有 7 种。 这种差异凸显了一个机会，即连接连续版本中的结构观察结果，并考察架构变更何时预示着性能恶化。 只要其应用和解释能够考虑到系统的演化过程，静态技术便能为这项研究做出贡献。

sents.en: The concentration of approaches, metrics, and tools around structural assessment gives researchers several ways to examine dependencies, modular boundaries, and architectural violations.
sents.zh: 围绕结构评估的各种方法、指标和工具的高度集中，为研究人员提供了多种途径来考察依赖关系、模块化边界以及架构违规问题。

paragraphs.en: Choosing among the available structural techniques requires understanding what additional evidence each contributes . Techniques may examine similar properties while relying on different assumptions, inputs, or thresholds. Combining them may broaden the assessment, but it may also reproduce the same information through several indicators. Comparative evaluations would help distinguish complementary measurements from redundant ones and establish whether their conclusions remain consistent across systems and stages of evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 在可用的结构技术中进行选择，需要理解每种技术能带来哪些额外的证据。 这些技术可能考察相似的特性，但依赖的假设、输入或阈值却有所不同。 将它们结合起来或许能拓展评估范围，但也可能通过多个指标重复呈现相同的信息。 通过比较性评估，有助于区分互补的测量与冗余的测量，并确定其结论在不同系统和演化阶段是否保持一致。

sents.zh: 在可用的结构技术中进行选择，需要理解每种技术能带来哪些额外的证据。

paragraphs.en: The breadth of remediation extends across implementation, architecture, and development practices, with 66 code-level, 64 architectural, and 65 organizational strategies. This range challenges a general characterization of remediation as immature and makes intervention selection a more precise concern. An architectural violation, for example, may require both a technical correction and changes to the practices that allowed it to recur. The catalogue identifies possible responses, but does not establish which combinations are appropriate under particular conditions. Studies connecting the diagnosed problem to the intervention rationale, implementation costs, and outcomes over subsequent releases would provide stronger guidance for these decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 修复工作的范围涵盖实施、架构和开发实践，其中包括 66 项代码级策略、64 项架构策略和 65 项组织策略。 这一范围对将修复工作视为不成熟的普遍看法提出了挑战，并使干预措施的选择成为一个更精确的问题。 例如，一项架构违规可能需要技术上的修正，也需要改变导致其重复出现的实践方式。 该目录列出了可能的应对方法，但并未明确在特定条件下哪些组合是合适的。 将诊断出的问题与干预理由、实施成本以及后续版本中的结果联系起来的研究，将为这些决策提供更强的指导。

sents.en: The breadth of remediation extends across implementation, architecture, and development practices, with 66 code-level, 64 architectural, and 65 organizational strategies.
sents.zh: 修复工作的范围涵盖实施、架构和开发实践，其中包括 66 项代码级策略、64 项架构策略和 65 项组织策略。

sents.zh: 例如，一项架构违规可能需要技术上的修正，也需要改变导致其重复出现的实践方式。

paragraphs.en: Repeated use of a smaller set of recovery tools or degradation-specific indicators could indicate consolidation , particularly when independent studies evaluate the same techniques under different conditions. The same concentration could also reflect limited alternatives or broad grouping during classification. Aggregate counts cannot distinguish these explanations. Establishing whether knowledge is accumulating requires examining how studies reuse earlier techniques, test their assumptions, and compare their findings. A small catalogue supported by repeated validation may offer more dependable guidance than a larger catalogue whose techniques remain difficult to compare.
paragraphs.zh: 反复使用较少的恢复工具或特定退化指标可能表明存在整合现象，尤其是在独立研究在不同条件下评估相同技术时。 相同的浓度也可能反映替代方案有限或在分类过程中进行了宽泛的分组。 汇总计数无法区分这些解释。 要确定知识是否在积累，需要考察研究如何重复使用早期技术、检验其假设并比较其发现。 一个经过反复验证的小型工具集可能比一个包含更多但技术间难以比较的大型工具集提供更可靠的指导。

sents.en: Repeated use of a smaller set of recovery tools or degradation-specific indicators could indicate consolidation , particularly when independent studies evaluate the same techniques under different conditions.
sents.zh: 反复使用较少的恢复工具或特定退化指标可能表明存在整合现象，尤其是在独立研究在不同条件下评估相同技术时。

sents.zh: 一个经过反复验证的小型工具集可能比一个包含更多但技术间难以比较的大型工具集提供更可靠的指导。

paragraphs.en: The 51 runtime and operational metrics and 45 evolutionary and change metrics provide varied ways to examine dimensions that receive less attention than structural assessment. Their contribution to degradation management depends on whether they inform actionable architectural decisions . Evaluations could trace whether changes in these indicators reveal a problem, influence the choice of an intervention, and capture its subsequent effects. This requires distinguishing execution behaviour from architectural change across versions: each provides different evidence, and neither alone establishes how degradation develops.
paragraphs.zh: 51项运行时和运行指标以及45项进化和变更指标，为考察那些相较于结构评估较少受到关注的维度提供了多样化的方法。 这些指标在退化管理中的贡献程度，取决于它们是否能够指导具有可操作性的架构决策。 评估可以追踪这些指标的变化是否揭示了问题、影响了干预措施的选择，并捕捉到其后续影响。 这需要在不同版本中区分执行行为与架构变更：两者提供的证据各不相同，且仅凭其中任何一种都无法确定退化是如何发展的。

sents.en: The 51 runtime and operational metrics and 45 evolutionary and change metrics provide varied ways to examine dimensions that receive less attention than structural assessment.
sents.zh: 51项运行时和运行指标以及45项进化和变更指标，为考察那些相较于结构评估较少受到关注的维度提供了多样化的方法。

sents.en: Their contribution to degradation management depends on whether they inform actionable architectural decisions .
sents.zh: 这些指标在退化管理中的贡献程度，取决于它们是否能够指导具有可操作性的架构决策。

sents.en: Evaluations could trace whether changes in these indicators reveal a problem, influence the choice of an intervention, and capture its subsequent effects.
sents.zh: 评估可以追踪这些指标的变化是否揭示了问题、影响了干预措施的选择，并捕捉到其后续影响。

sents.en: This requires distinguishing execution behaviour from architectural change across versions: each provides different evidence, and neither alone establishes how degradation develops.
sents.zh: 这需要在不同版本中区分执行行为与架构变更：两者提供的证据各不相同，且仅凭其中任何一种都无法确定退化是如何发展的。

paragraphs.en: Comparative studies would make extensive catalogues easier to use by clarifying technique selection and applicability. For smaller catalogues, evaluations should establish whether existing techniques adequately cover the relevant degradation phenomena and produce reliable findings. Following the connection from measurement to intervention and sustained outcomes would address both needs, showing how the available contributions support degradation management in practice. This would provide empirical support for the combined use of prevention, detection, and repair advocated by previous reviews ( Silva and Balasubramaniam, 2012 ; Li et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 比较研究通过明确技术选择和适用性，将使大型目录更易于使用。 对于较小的目录，评估应确定现有技术是否充分覆盖了相关的退化现象，并能得出可靠的结论。 建立从测量到干预及持续结果的关联，将同时满足这两种需求，并展示现有成果如何在实践中支持退化管理。 这将为先前综述所倡导的预防、检测与修复相结合的方法提供实证支持（Silva and Balasubramaniam, 2012；Li et al., 2022）。

sents.zh: 比较研究通过明确技术选择和适用性，将使大型目录更易于使用。
